title: InfoCD: A Contrastive Chamfer Distance Loss for Point Cloud Completion
tldr_zh: 对比正则改进 CD，作者报告等价于最大化底层曲面互信息下界，被 UOT-UPC 选为最优 cost。
tldr_en: Contrastive regularization improves CD; authors report equivalence to maximizing a lower bound on underlying surface mutual information; selected as optimal cost by UOT-UPC.
